yaml_text:
factor:
  name: reg_pe_hist
  name_cn: "经过历史增速变化调整的历史 PE 变化"
  category: 价值
  direction: -1
  column: reg_pe_hist
  description: >
    先计算单季净利润同比、净利润 TTM、PE_TTM 的 log 值并做 60 日差分；
    再通过两步截面回归依次剥离 TTM 变化与独立利润动量，
    最终残差 reg_pe_hist 代表无法被利润解释的情绪性估值变化。

universe:
  primary_index: ALL

calculation_steps:
  - name: 获取基础数据
    action: fetch
    api: get_factor
    fields: [net_profit_mrq_0, net_profit_mrq_4, net_profit_ttm, pe_ratio_ttm]
    output_columns:
      net_profit_mrq_0: net_profit_mrq_0
      net_profit_mrq_4: net_profit_mrq_4
      net_profit_ttm: net_profit_ttm
      pe_ratio_ttm: pe_ratio_ttm

  - name: 过滤正值要求
    action: filter
    condition: net_profit_mrq_0 > 0 and net_profit_mrq_4 > 0 and net_profit_ttm > 0 and pe_ratio_ttm > 0

  - name: 计算单季净利润同比对数
    action: compute
    formula: log(net_profit_mrq_0 / net_profit_mrq_4)
    source_columns: [net_profit_mrq_0, net_profit_mrq_4]
    output_column: log_yoy

  - name: 计算净利润TTM对数
    action: compute
    formula: log(net_profit_ttm)
    source_columns: [net_profit_ttm]
    output_column: log_npttm

  - name: 计算PE_TTM对数
    action: compute
    formula: log(pe_ratio_ttm)
    source_columns: [pe_ratio_ttm]
    output_column: log_pe

  - name: 计算60日差分log_yoy
    action: transform
    method: diff
    source_column: log_yoy
    output_column: delta_log_yoy
    periods: 60
    group_by: order_book_id

  - name: 计算60日差分log_npttm
    action: transform
    method: diff
    source_column: log_npttm
    output_column: delta_log_npttm
    periods: 60
    group_by: order_book_id

  - name: 计算60日差分log_pe
    action: transform
    method: diff
    source_column: log_pe
    output_column: delta_log_pe
    periods: 60
    group_by: order_book_id

  - name: 截面回归剥离TTM变化
    action: cross_section_regress
    source_column_y: delta_log_yoy
    source_columns_x: [delta_log_npttm]
    output_column: residual_1
    add_intercept: true

  - name: 截面回归剥离独立利润动量
    action: cross_section_regress
    source_column_y: delta_log_pe
    source_columns_x: [residual_1]
    output_column: reg_pe_hist
    add_intercept: true
